text: Ivory for DSH 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的界面主题插件，通过客户端注入暖中性色样式，并在设置页提供主题与专注模式开关。它调整浅色和深色界面的视觉呈现，适配窄屏布局与日常对话阅读；遇到 Markdown 文档时可显示源码与预览切换，预览支持标题、列表、表格和链接等常见格式。适合希望改善 DSH 网页阅读体验并预览生成的 Markdown 文件的用户。偏好保存在浏览器本地，不需要额外 API 密钥。

Ivory for DSH is a visual theme for DSH Web. It adds warm neutral styling, light and dark appearances, and theme and focus controls in Settings. Markdown documents get a source/preview toggle with common formatting. Preferences stay in browser storage; no API key is needed.
想给 DSH 网页版换成更柔和的浅色和深色主题
DSH 对话界面有没有适合长文本阅读的外观
让窄屏或手机窗口里的 DSH 页面更好用
我想在 DSH 设置里切换主题和专注阅读模式
DSH 输出 Markdown 文件时能不能直接看排版预览
I want a calmer light and dark theme for the DSH web interface.
Can I preview Markdown documents produced in my DSH conversations?
Make the DSH conversation layout easier to read in a narrow window.
Ivory for DSH 的功能「主题外观」：插件在 DSH Web 中注入 Ivory 样式，调整浅色和深色界面的色彩、排版及对话区域布局。
Ivory for DSH 的功能「主题与专注模式」：设置页提供主题启用和专注模式开关；选择会记在浏览器本地，并随插件状态更新。
Ivory for DSH 的功能「Markdown 文档预览」：识别 Markdown 代码块或 .md 文件内容后生成预览，并提供源码/预览按钮；超出渲染预算时保留源码。
Ivory for DSH: Markdown documents receive a preview toggle; oversized input stays available as source.

dsh-ivory README · Introduction：Ivory gives the DSH web interface a quieter reading rhythm without changing how
the harness works. Warm neutrals replace cold grays, editorial type improves
long responses, and the conversation stays usable from a narrow phone window
to a wide desktop. DeepSeek branding and every native DSH capability remain in
place.

dsh-ivory README · Quick start：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ivory
dsh web
```

Hard-refresh the page with `Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + R`, then open
**Settings → Ivory Theme**. The main theme is enabled by default; the optional
focus mode stays off until you choose it.

On macOS desktop, install `dsh-ivory` from **Plugins → Add plugin**.
Upgrades preserve the saved theme preference; if the interface still looks
unchanged, check **Settings → Ivory Theme → Enable Ivory theme**.

dsh-ivory README · Quick start：
Pin a release or uninstall Install the exact GitHub release without using npm. ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:ZJUZhiyuCai/dsh-ivory#v0.2.17 ``` Remove Ivory and return to the native DSH interface. ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-ivory ```

dsh-ivory README · Made for everyday DSH：| Area | What Ivory changes |
| --- | --- |
| **Appearance** | Layered neutral navigation, softer reading ink and a lightly outlined composer, with consistent spacing and interaction in both themes. |
| **Files and attachments** | Consistent preview tabs, readable file cards and responsive file toolbars; document scrolling, code wrapping and image zoom stay native. |
| **Plugin management** | Compact divided lists, readable component descriptions, clear switches and responsive package/source details, with matching install fields. |
| **Responsive layout** | The home adapts to window height and available writing space; conversations retain host-adaptive sizing and width dragging across narrow, split and short windows. |
| **Reading and copying** | Independent controls for prose, user bubbles, and code blocks, plus a small end-of-response marker. |
| **Markdown documents** | A bounded, DOM-built preview for `.md` output with source view always available and HTTP(S)-only links. |
| **Accessibility** | Keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, forced-colors fallbacks, and WCAG AA muted text contrast. |

dsh-ivory README · Quiet by design：Ivory is a browser-only visual plugin. Its host entry point is intentionally
inert.

dsh-ivory README · Quiet by design：| Boundary | Ivory behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Bundled runtime dependencies | None. DSH client modules and React are peers. |
| Filesystem and process access | None. |
| Network requests and telemetry | None. |
| Persistent data | Two local preference flags in `localStorage`. |
| User content | Presented in the browser; copied only after an explicit click. |
| Third-party branding | No Anthropic fonts, logos, icons, or application code. |

dsh-ivory README · Quiet by design：> [!NOTE]
> DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview and may make breaking UI changes.
> Ivory 0.2.17 is verified against DSH Web 0.2.1-rc.1 and desktop
> 0.2.1-rc.2. Other host builds may use token-level fallback. When Ivory cannot prove the current structural
> contract, it keeps token-level theming and releases the host layout back to DSH.

dsh-ivory README · Quiet by design：The 0.2.1 port re-verified every aliased CSS-module class, added the account-menu
settings trigger and the running-state text seam, and retinted the host's new
deep-diving alias tokens; see `src/host-selectors.json` for the verified map. Run
`npm run build && npm run test:desktop` for isolated regressions
using styles read from the installed app (no account or model calls).
`DSH_DESKTOP_CLIENT_DIR` can point to extracted client bundles plus the frontend
`index-*.css` on other systems. `DSH_WEB_PACKAGE_DIR` selects the installed
`@deepseek-ai/dsh` package used for the separate Web stylesheet tests.

dsh-ivory README · Quiet by design：`derive:host` previews a mapping resolved by package, CSS module and member name.
Use `npm run derive:host -- --check` to fail on drift, or
`npm run derive:host -- --write` to save a complete result. Missing or ambiguous
modules fail without writing a partial table. Update the recorded host versions,
peer range and any desktop-only selectors when adapting a new host release.
Then run `npm run snapshot:host -- --write` to extract matching module exports
from both installed hosts. The default tests and release gates compare the actual
alias table with these versioned snapshots, including component identity.

dsh-ivory README · Quiet by design：`npm test` includes isolated browser checks for content replacement, bounded
Markdown rendering, copy-button ownership, storage failures and drift diagnostics.
Install its browser once with `npx --no-install playwright-core install chromium`,
or set `DSH_QA_CHROMIUM` to an existing browser. CI installs Chromium automatically.
Complex Markdown retains the complete source when its render budget is exceeded.
Preference changes work for the current session even when storage is unavailable.

dsh-ivory README · Quiet by design：The live browser entries require `DSH_QA_TOKEN` from the `dsh web` URL.
Every `qa:*` entry point is documented here and checked by the release gate.

The browser suite covers responsive layout, composer focus, dark mode,
Markdown injection attempts, streaming state, lifecycle cleanup, block-copy
payloads, plugin coexistence, long tables, reduced motion, and forced colors.

dsh-ivory README · Quiet by design：Releases use npm Trusted Publisher with GitHub OIDC. The repository stores no long-lived npm publish token, and future CI releases receive npm provenance automatically.
Development ```sh npm ci npm run build dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD Edit `src/skin.css`, `src/client.template.js`, or `src/markdown.js`, then run `npm run build`. The generated `lib/client.js` is committed so GitHub installs need no build permission.
